title: trackerCpuBudget
responsibility: Defines MB2's shared core budget for work outside Harbor: which work it covers, the session cap, the worker environment limits and the brief instruction.

inputs.name: trackerBudgetNode.node
inputs.description: Canonical name of the computer being checked.

inputs.name: trackerCpuBudget.node
inputs.description: Canonical name of the computer that would run the work.

inputs.name: trackerCpuBudget.project
inputs.description: Project or agent of the work. Anything other than Harbor, including none, is budgeted on MB2.

inputs.name: trackerCpuBudgetEnvironment.cores
inputs.description: Number of cores that cooperating build tools may use.

inputs.name: trackerCpuBudgetRule.cores
inputs.description: Number of cores stated in the worker brief.

outputs.name: trackerHomeProject
outputs.description: Lower-case name of the project exempt from the MB2 budget.

outputs.name: trackerBudgetCores
outputs.description: Cores shared by all MB2 work outside Harbor, also the load ceiling for starting it.

outputs.name: trackerBudgetSessions
outputs.description: Number of sessions outside Harbor that MB2 runs at once.

outputs.name: trackerBudgetNode
outputs.description: True when the computer applies the budget.

outputs.name: trackerCpuBudget
outputs.description: Core limit for the work, or undefined when no budget applies.

outputs.name: trackerCpuBudgetEnvironment
outputs.description: NAME=value assignments that cap build, make and runtime parallelism.

outputs.name: trackerCpuBudgetRule
outputs.description: Brief paragraph telling the worker how to stay within the budget.
